Card Q&A.q: I have 2 or fewer security cards or 3 or more [Hero] trait Tamers with different names. Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect at the same time as an effect such as P-103 [Offense Training]'s effect that digivolves?

Effect: [Your Turn] While you have 2 or fewer security cards or 3 or more [Hero] trait Tamers with different names, this Digimon may digivolve into [Siriusmon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
